scope: Full production scene with real physical E and phase controller. Doors are measured from actual MeshInstance3D transforms; labels, active Camera3D, passenger bounds/control and finite differences of logical travel are independently observed. Passenger remains fixed inside a detached opaque car; logical floor progress is not physical travel through source slabs. Scenario starts and landing obstruction are explicit test-only fixtures. Headless defers native viewport captures; safety faults are also retained in check_building_visits. User settings and running native game are untouched. No human-input, whole-city route, surveyed shaft or performance/export acceptance.
